features: Dual-lens video doorbell: 3 MP main camera (visitors) + 2 MP sub camera (ground/package view)
Motion detection, human body detection and package detection alarms to app and NVR
True HDR and DWDR (main camera 80 dB, sub camera 58 dB)
IR + white-light illumination (IR 5 m, white light 2 m)
Dual-band Wi-Fi 2.4/5 GHz with Wi-Fi 6 (802.11 b/g/n/ax), integrated BLE, Sub-1GHz wireless chime
Noise suppression, app calling, connection to Uniview NVR for live view/playback/alarm search
Supports mechanical chime and wireless chime

frigate.notes: Dual-lens Wi-Fi doorbell. Supports RTSP (network protocol TCP/IP, HTTP, RTP, RTSP, NTP) and connection to a Uniview NVR; no ONVIF advertised (UNV private protocol). Exact RTSP stream path not published by the manufacturer.

home_assistant.notes: RTSP stream (generic camera). No ONVIF; UNV private protocol plus RTSP.

blue_iris.notes: Uniview RTSP; exact path not published.
